text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. Total bilirubin is slightly elevated, while other liver and kidney parameters are within normal limits. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, possible bone marrow suppression, and mild liver dysfunction. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
